description:
Overview

Keysight is a mission-critical design enablement partner for organizations solving the world’s most complex engineering challenges. With deep engineering expertise and leading design, emulation, and test solutions, our ~16,800 employees help customers in over 100 countries accelerate innovation across communications, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace and defense, semiconductor, and artificial intelligence markets. Learn more about what we do.

 

At Keysight, people come together to explore new ideas, challenge what's possible, and advance the technologies defining the future. Here, you'll find opportunities to do your best work, take your career further, and thrive in an award-winning culture. Learn more about our benefits.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do

As a contributor to the oscilloscope applications team, you'll own significant portions of the software stack, from algorithm development to customer-facing functionality.

You will:

Design, develop, and maintain Windows-based application software for industry-leading oscilloscopes.
Create advanced signal analysis and processing algorithms used by engineers worldwide.
Develop automated test frameworks and self-test capabilities to ensure product quality and reliability.
Apply modern AI technologies to improve engineering workflows and deliver intelligent features directly to customers.
Partner with customers, product planners, marketing, and QA teams to identify user needs and transform them into impactful software solutions.
Drive features through the full software development lifecycle, from concept and architecture to implementation, testing, and release.
Contribute to an agile development environment focused on continuous innovation and rapid delivery.

What Makes This Role Exciting

Work on products that are considered the gold standard in electronic measurement.
Combine software engineering, user interface design, embedded systems, signal processing, and AI technologies in one role.
Collaborate with highly skilled engineers across multiple technical disciplines.
Solve challenging real-world problems for customers developing tomorrow's technologies.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Upcoming or recent graduate with Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering
Experience working with embedded systems, microcontrollers, or hardware-integrated software.
An understanding of electrical engineering principles, digital design, and electronic components
Working knowledge of object-oriented programming.

Desired Qualifications

Proficiency in C++ or C# Development
Knowledge of signal processing, analog circuits, or mixed-signal systems.
Hands-on experience with oscilloscopes or other electronic test and measurement equipment.
 

Why Join Us?

You'll work on products that enable breakthroughs across communications, semiconductor technology, aerospace, automotive, and scientific research. If you're passionate about software engineering, enjoy working closely with hardware, and want to build innovative AI-powered solutions that make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Other Information

The level of role will be based on applicable experience, education and skills; Most offers will be between the minimum and the midpoint of the Salary Range listed below.
Colorado Pay Range MIN $89,600.00, Mid. $119,460.00, MAX $149,330.00

Note: For other locations, pay ranges will vary by region

 

This position is on-site in Colorado Springs, Colorado

Relocation is available for this position

Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position

This position requires access to technology and/or technical data that is subject to U.S. export controls. Candidates need to be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3). 

 

US Employees may be eligible for the following benefits:

- Medical, dental and vision

- Health Savings Account

- Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts

- Life, Accident, Disability insurance

- Business Travel Accident and Business Travel Health

- 401(k) Plan

- Flexible Time Off, Paid Holidays

- Paid Family Leave

- Discounts, Perks

- Tuition Reimbursement

- Adoption Assistance

- ESPP (Employee Stock Purchase Plan)
